scripts.start: npx concurrently --kill-others -n "BACKEND,MOBILE" -c "magenta,cyan" "python -m uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "npm --prefix mobile start"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "cd backend && uvicorn main:app --reload"
